description: This file defines the high-level API functions for the Energy Efficient Ethernet (EEE) feature for Realtek RTL8367/RTL8367C switch series. It declares initialization, enable, and status query functions related to EEE port configurations.

methods.name: rtk_eee_init
methods.description: Initializes the EEE (Energy Efficient Ethernet) feature, setting its status to default.

methods.name: rtk_eee_portEnable_set
methods.description: Enables or disables EEE on a specific port.

methods.name: rtk_eee_portEnable_get
methods.description: Retrieves the current EEE enable status of a specific port.
